# Mahjongers

> Mahjongers helps mahjong teachers, hosts, clubs and shops grow. Our main service, Mahjongers Social, is done-for-you social media management (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, LinkedIn) priced in US dollars. Operated by Move78 Hospitality, India.

## Services
- [Mahjongers Social — plans and pricing](https://mahjongers.com/social-media): Starter $350/month (2 platforms, 12 posts incl. 4 Reels), Pro $750/month (3 platforms, 20 posts incl. 8 Reels, Stories, DMs), Max $1,500/month (4 platforms, 30 posts incl. 12 Reels, daily Stories and DMs, paid ads managed). 3-month minimum, then month to month. Clients keep ownership of their accounts.
- [Get started](https://mahjongers.com/join): contact form for new clients.
